title: Convection‐permitting dynamical downscaling of ERA5 for Europe and the Mediterranean basin
journal: Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society

idea.research_question: Can reanalysis-driven downscaling improve the spatial and temporal representation of precipitation extremes and hydroclimatic variability?
idea.hypothesis: ERA5 provides dynamically consistent large-scale forcing while precipitation observations constrain local bias; their combination should improve extreme-event representation over a reanalysis-only baseline.
idea.mechanism: ERA5 fields are dynamically downscaled and evaluated against gridded precipitation observations using common temporal windows, extremes and spatial cross-validation.
idea.analytical_approach: Dynamical or statistical downscaling, bias evaluation and precipitation-extreme analysis
idea.expected_contribution: A reproducible benchmark for testing whether a proposed idea preserves all required data roles and adds auxiliary data only for a distinct mechanism, validation or refinement purpose.
idea.falsification_condition: The idea fails if it drops a required role, cannot align the required inputs, or does not improve explanatory, predictive or validation performance over the appropriate single-source baseline.
